description: Does a helper for this already exist? Near-duplicate search over the indexed code: target an existing symbol or paste a snippet. Uses local embedding vectors when ready ([cos]), degrading to token-shingle text similarity ([jaccard]) while embedding coverage builds.

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

min_similarity.description: cosine floor for embedding hits (the text fallback uses its own)

path.description: with line: innermost symbol at that position

snippet.description: code or a description of it, when there is no existing symbol to compare

name: find_similar_code
title: Find similar code
